entities.name: PP242
observations: Dual mTORC1/mTORC2 inhibitor; MeSH C572919. In PC12 xenografts, significantly reduced mean tumor volume versus comparator groups and increased TUNEL-detected apoptosis; effects exceeded rapamycin in the reported study.
PMID 25440763 and PMID 25666752 abstracts did not provide a PP242 dose or quantitative dose-response curve.

entities.name: Pheochromocytoma
observations: Pheochromocytoma maps to MONDO:0008233, DOID:0050771, and MeSH D010673.

entities.name: PC12
observations: Rat pheochromocytoma cell line; Cellosaurus CVCL:0481. Used for nude-mouse xenografts in the directly relevant PP242 study.

entities.name: PMID:25440763
observations: Urology (2015): PP242 showed strong antitumor activity in a pheochromocytoma PC12 cell tumor model. In nude-mouse PC12 xenografts, PP242 reduced tumor volume and increased apoptosis, while inhibiting p-Akt, reducing Bcl-2 and VEGF, and increasing Bax; effects were stronger than rapamycin.

entities.name: PMID:25666752
observations: Tumour Biology (2015): In PC12 models, mTORC2 or dual mTORC1/mTORC2 inhibition promoted apoptosis; mTORC2 inhibition suppressed proliferation more effectively than mTORC1 inhibition. PP242 was more potent than rapamycin at inhibiting xenograft growth.
